description: Create a TouchDesigner-side OBS control scaffold with obs-websocket v5 request templates, status/setup DATs, and optional NDI or Syphon/Spout TOP publishing for OBS capture. The optional OBS password is passed only to the bridge payload and is redacted from all returned reports.

active.description: Start websocket/sender operators active immediately. Defaults off for setup.

name.description: Container name for the OBS scaffold.

obs_url.description: OBS obs-websocket URL. OBS 28+ includes obs-websocket by default.

output_mode.description: How to expose source_top_path for OBS capture.

parent_path.description: COMP that will receive the OBS recorder control scaffold.

password.description: Optional OBS websocket password. Never echoed in returned reports.

recording_profile.description: Operator-facing recording profile label stored in the scaffold status.

scene_name.description: Optional OBS scene name for scene switch requests.

source_top_path.description: Optional TD TOP to publish to OBS through NDI or Syphon/Spout.

name: connect_obs_recorder
title: Connect OBS Recorder
